title: Write a mutation-proof unittest suite for a grandfather-father-son backup retention planner

hidden_checks.spec: How your tests are graded: every test must pass against the unmodified retention/policy.py (and at least one test must run).
Rule 2: a backup with taken_at > now is neither kept nor deleted; listed in skipped; takes part in no other rule.
Rule 2: a backup taken exactly at now is not in the future.
Rule 4: pinned backups are invisible to rules 5-7 (never chosen for a slot; pinned-only days use no slot).
Rule 5: the `daily` most recent distinct dates that have backups, not the last `daily` calendar days before now.
Rule 6: ISO weeks identified by ISO year and ISO week (2024-12-30 and 2025-01-02 are both 2025-W01).
Rules 7/8: keep the newest backup of each of the `monthly` most recent months.
Rule 8: ties on greatest taken_at go to the greatest id (rules 3 and 5-7).
Rule 9: only age strictly greater than max_age_days is too old; exactly max_age_days old is not.
Rule 9: backups kept by rule 4 (pinned) are never deleted for age.
Rule 9: backups kept by rule 3 (latest) are never deleted for age.
Rule 11: delete is ordered oldest first (taken_at, then id, ascending).
Rule 11: reasons listed in the fixed order latest, pinned, daily, weekly, monthly.
